items.scope: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY live observation-event fanout replaced by snapshot/polling event delivery
items.proof: Worker production observation event APIs already serve D1-native recent/live snapshot routes with x-ikimon-observation-event-live-mode=snapshot-only. Node origin SSE now emits only the initial snapshot and relies on the existing client polling fallback, removing PG LISTEN/NOTIFY fanout.
